# Japan Tax Advisor

> > International tax advisory firm specializing in transfer pricing, cross-border taxation, and compliance for foreign companies operating in Japan.

Japan Tax Advisor (JTA Tax Corporation) is a boutique tax advisory firm with Big4 expertise offering specialized services in transfer pricing, M&A taxation, real estate investment structuring, and international tax compliance. The firm serves multinational enterprises and foreign investors navigating Japan's complex tax environment.

## Key Topics

- Transfer Pricing
- International Tax
- Japan Tax Compliance
- Cross-Border Taxation
- M&A Tax Advisory
- Foreign Investment in Japan
- Global Minimum Tax
- National Tax Agency
- Permanent Establishment (PE)
- Withholding Tax
- Tax Structuring
- Real Estate Investment
- Business Succession
- Inheritance Tax
- OECD Guidelines
